title: History 1414 full eligible diff: Bug 1927998 - Store OAuth2 scopes separately. r=leftmostcat,mkmelin,babolivier I've changed `getHostnameDetails` to take an optional second argument, and return a list of required scopes (based on the new argument) as well as a list of all scopes.
